_about: Hand-kept input to tools/catalogue/generate.py. Review every entry at each release: see tools/catalogue/README.md.

Workflow.page: The palette lists **For each** first in this category. It isn't a catalogue task: it repeats a task once per item of a list. See [For each](../fundamentals/tasks#for-each).

IBM Services Essentials.page: These tasks call IBM Services Essentials services. They work only on a Flow installation that runs inside IBM Services Essentials.
IBM Services Essentials.task: Works only on a Flow installation that runs inside IBM Services Essentials.
IBM Services Essentials.overview: The IBM Services Essentials tasks work only on a Flow installation that runs inside IBM Services Essentials.

execute-basic-http-call.text: Every revision sends no request and ends `succeeded` on `boomerangio/task-flow:3.3.0`, the default task image, so a later task that reads `response` or `statusCode` gets nothing. The fix is in task-flow 3.4.0, which isn't released. See [The HTTP Call tasks do nothing](../introduction/known-issues#the-http-call-tasks-do-nothing).

execute-advanced-http-call.text: Every revision sends no request and ends `succeeded` on `boomerangio/task-flow:3.3.0`, the default task image, so a later task that reads `response` or `statusCode` gets nothing. The fix is in task-flow 3.4.0, which isn't released. See [The HTTP Call tasks do nothing](../introduction/known-issues#the-http-call-tasks-do-nothing).

send-email-with-sendgrid.text: Revisions 1 and 2 do nothing and end `succeeded`: the command they call is no longer in the task image. Later revisions work. Upgrade a node pinned to revision 1 or 2 in the editor. See [Some older task revisions do nothing](../introduction/known-issues#some-older-task-revisions-do-nothing).

find-repositories-in-org.text: Revision 1 does nothing and ends `succeeded`: the command it calls is no longer in the task image. Later revisions work. Upgrade a node pinned to revision 1 in the editor. See [Some older task revisions do nothing](../introduction/known-issues#some-older-task-revisions-do-nothing).

run-python-script.text: Revision 1 does nothing and ends `succeeded`: the command it calls is no longer in the task image. Later revisions work. Upgrade a node pinned to revision 1 in the editor. See [Some older task revisions do nothing](../introduction/known-issues#some-older-task-revisions-do-nothing).

upload-slack-file-with-message.text: Every revision calls a Slack method that Slack has retired, so the task fails. For a text file, Send Slack Message with File Contents posts the file's contents through an incoming webhook. See [Upload Slack File with Message fails](../introduction/known-issues#upload-slack-file-with-message-fails).

manual-approval.text: The hint for **Number of Approvals (optional)** says "Only respected if Approver Group is specified", but Flow applies the number whether or not you choose an approver group. Leave it blank when one approval is enough. See [Number of Approvals applies without an approver group](../introduction/known-issues#number-of-approvals-applies-without-an-approver-group).

acquire-lock.text: Revision 1 says **Timeout** is in seconds and defaults it to 300, but Flow reads it in milliseconds, so the lock expires after 300 milliseconds. Revision 2 says milliseconds and defaults to 300000, which is 5 minutes. Upgrade a node pinned to revision 1 in the editor.

revision.description: Upload a file or folder from the run workspace as an artifact of this run or of the workflow.

params.name: name
params.label: Artifact name
params.helpertext: Unique within the run. Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore.

params.name: path
params.label: Path
params.helpertext: A file or folder to upload; a folder is sent as one .tar.gz. Relative to /workspace (e.g. workflowrun/reports/sbom.json), or an absolute path.

params.name: scope
params.label: Scope
params.helpertext: run: this run only, expires on its retention date. workflow: kept for every later run of this workflow until replaced.

params.name: retention-days
params.label: Retention days
params.helpertext: Blank keeps it for the workspace's retention. You can ask for fewer days, not more. Not allowed with scope workflow.

params.name: url
params.label: Upload link
params.helpertext: Filled in by Flow when the task runs.

params.name: headers
params.label: Upload headers
params.helpertext: Filled in by Flow when the task runs.

revision.description: Download an artifact of this run, or the workflow's kept artifact of that name, into the run workspace, checking its SHA-256.

params.name: name
params.label: Artifact name
params.helpertext: An artifact an earlier task in this run uploaded, or with scope workflow the workflow's kept artifact of that name.

params.name: path
params.label: Destination path
params.helpertext: Where to put it; an uploaded folder is unpacked here. Relative to /workspace (e.g. workflowrun/inputs/), or an absolute path.

params.name: scope
params.label: Scope
params.helpertext: run: this run only, expires on its retention date. workflow: kept for every later run of this workflow until replaced.

params.name: optional
params.label: Optional
params.helpertext: Succeed with result found=false when no artifact of this name exists, instead of failing.

params.name: url
params.label: Download link
params.helpertext: Filled in by Flow when the task runs.

params.name: headers
params.label: Download headers
params.helpertext: Filled in by Flow when the task runs.

params.name: sha256
params.label: SHA-256
params.helpertext: Filled in by Flow when the task runs.

params.name: contentType
params.label: Content type
params.helpertext: Filled in by Flow when the task runs.
